steps.name: tool-hydrometer-temperature-correction
steps.summary: Created lib/utils/hydrometerCorrection.ts (correctGravity, fahrenheitFromCelsius, celsiusFromFahrenheit) with 25 passing tests; added HydrometerCorrectionTool.tsx client component with °F/°C toggle, 59°F/68°F calibration presets, opt-in localStorage for calibration temp; added tools-config.ts entry (disclaimerType: general, aiOverviewResistance: high, relatedToolIds: [homebrew-recipe-calculator]); created /beer/hydrometer-temperature-correction page (EN+KO, og:image: /og/default-{en,ko}.png). Build: lint pass, 394 tests pass, static export builds both locales.

steps.name: tool-standard-drinks-calculator
steps.summary: Created lib/utils/standardDrinksCalculator.ts (calculateStandardDrinks, GRAMS_PER_STANDARD_DRINK for us/uk/au-sg/canada) with 18 passing tests; added StandardDrinksCalculatorTool.tsx client component with drink-type presets, mL/fl oz toggle, 4-country standard selector, weekly recommended limits, BAC link; added tools-config.ts entry (disclaimerType: medical, aiOverviewResistance: high, relatedToolIds: [bac-calculator]); created /beer/standard-drinks-calculator page (EN+KO) with confirmed 5-element disclaimer paragraph, og:image /og/default-{en,ko}.png. lint pass, 412 tests pass, static export builds both locales.

steps.name: bac-calculator-enhancements
steps.summary: Extended calculateBac to return hoursUntilZeroPercent (bacPercent/0.015, rounded to 1dp, 0 when BAC=0) with 5 new tests (417 total pass); upgraded BAC display to text-5xl; added hoursUntilZeroPercent secondary display with neutral label; added Widmark formula display block in result card and page.tsx description; added BacReferenceTable (7 BAC ranges from NIAAA/CDC, highlights current range with no safe/unsafe framing); updated tools-config.ts bac-calculator relatedToolIds to include standard-drinks-calculator; added new FAQ entry 'Once 0% time passes, is it safe to drive?' with 'No' answer. lint pass, 417 tests pass, static export builds both locales.
